personas.persona: Non-technical founder who wants a working web app fast.
prompts: Build me a simple to-do list web app: add tasks, mark them complete, delete them, and keep them saved in the browser between reloads. Then tell me how to open it.

expectations.outcome: A working to-do list web app, delivered as a running Minds app tab the client can open. Tasks can be added, marked complete, and deleted, and the list survives a page reload.

ui_flows.name: add-complete-delete
ui_flows.steps: Open the app. Add a task named 'buy milk'. Mark it complete. Add a task named 'walk dog'. Delete 'walk dog'.
ui_flows.expect: 'buy milk' is visible and shown as completed; 'walk dog' is gone.

ui_flows.name: persistence
ui_flows.steps: Open the app. Add a task named 'persist me'. Reload the page.
ui_flows.expect: 'persist me' is still visible after the reload.

prompts: Build a clean single-page marketing site for a product called 'Focus' with a hero headline, three feature cards, and an email signup form. Show me how to run it locally.

expectations.outcome: A single-page marketing site for a product called 'Focus', delivered as a running Minds app tab the client can open. The page carries a hero headline, three feature cards, and an email signup form.

ui_flows.name: hero-and-signup
ui_flows.steps: Open the page. Read the hero headline and the feature cards. Type 'founder@example.com' into the email signup field and submit it.
ui_flows.expect: The page shows a hero headline, three feature cards, and an email signup form that accepted the address and acknowledged the submission rather than erroring.
